tasks.description: Independently review manual completion of one owner-bound first-aid control, with an idempotent observation and canonical owner sync.
constraints: English independent Reviewer and QA. Local gates only. Controller owns staging and checks weekly usage limits.
Preserve prior command and sync payloads, reuse operation receipts, and scope observations to the owner and plant. An exact replay survives expiry and undo.
Prove both orders of a competing undo and expiry reached during lock contention, using separate PostgreSQL connections. Check absence of new AI jobs, quotas and schedules.
Photo upload and attachment lifecycle is a separate packet. No KB publication, 024, StoreKit or live pending deadline.

acceptance_criteria.description: Production entrypoints type-check and exact diff is clean.
HTTP and SQL fixtures verify the closed payload, owner and plant isolation, exact receipt, sync history, genuine undo and expiry races, and no AI or quota writes.
